#!/bin/bash
# Proposed guard: sanitized env + stat .git + POSITIVE SELF-TEST that the
# sandbox's own rev-parse resolves to the sandbox, before the hook ever runs.
set -u
B=$(mktemp -d /tmp/st-XXXX); git init -q "$B/real"; mkdir -p "$B/real/.tmp"
ln -s "$B/real" "$B/link"

guard() {
  local label="$1" tmpbase="$2"; shift 2
  local sb; sb=$(mktemp -d "$tmpbase/ethos-doctor-hook-XXXX")
  local senv=(env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$sb" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null)
  "${senv[@]}" git -C "$sb" init -q --template= >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%-28s REFUSE (init rc)\n' "$label"; return; }
  [ -d "$sb/.git" ] || { printf '%-28s REFUSE (no .git after init)\n' "$label"; return; }
  local top; top=$( cd "$sb" && "${senv[@]}" git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null )
  if [ "$(cd "$sb" && pwd -P)" != "$(cd "$top" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" ]; then
    printf '%-28s REFUSE (self-test: toplevel=%s)\n' "$label" "$top"; return
  fi
  printf '%-28s RUN HOOK (contained at %s)\n' "$label" "$top"
}

export GIT_DIR="$B/real/.git";                       guard "caller GIT_DIR"        "$B/real/.tmp"; unset GIT_DIR
export GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$B/real/.git/objects";  guard "caller GIT_OBJECT_DIR" "$B/real/.tmp"; unset GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY
export GIT_WORK_TREE=.;                              guard "caller GIT_WORK_TREE"  "$B/real/.tmp"; unset GIT_WORK_TREE
export GIT_COMMON_DIR="$B/real/.git";                guard "caller GIT_COMMON_DIR" "$B/real/.tmp"; unset GIT_COMMON_DIR
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.bare GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=true
                                                     guard "caller GIT_CONFIG_*"   "$B/real/.tmp"
unset GIT_CONFIG_COUNT GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0
                                                     guard "TMPDIR via symlink"    "$B/link/.tmp"
                                                     guard "clean"                 "$B/real/.tmp"
EOF
bash <repo>/.tmp/secreview/selftest.sh
